in_sanskrit.name: वंशिराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Lord of Serpents, The One who possesses the power to control serpents, The King

in_marathi.name: VamsiRaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vamshi, King
in_marathi.long_meaning: VamsiRaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vamsi: Lord Vamshi, the god of the forest and protector of the animals. Raj: King. This name evokes a sense of power and protection, and is often given to boys who are destined to become leaders and protectors.
